{{verse|chapter=7|verse=12}} {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Luc. 6, 31.''}}* Al things therfore vvhat{{ls}}oeuer you vvil that men doe to you doe you al{{ls}}o to them. For this is the Lavv and the Prophets.

{{verse|chapter=7|verse=13}} {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Luc. 13, 24.''}}* Enter ye by the narrovv gate: becau{{ls}}e brode is the gate, and large is the vvay that leadeth to perdition, and many there be that enter by it. {{verse|chapter=7|verse=14}} Hovv narrovv is the gate, and {{ls}}traite is the vvay that leadeth to life: and fevv there are that finde it!

{{verse|chapter=7|verse=15}} {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=The Go{{ls}}pel on the 7 Sunday after Penteco{{ls}}t.}}Take ye great heede of fal{{ls}}e Prophets, vvhich come to you in the {{sup|‖}} clothing of {{ls}}heepe, but invvardly are rauening vvolues. {{verse|chapter=7|verse=16}} By their {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Luc. 6, 44.''}}* {{sup|‖}} fruites you {{ls}}hal knovv them. Do men gather grapes of thornes, or figges of thi{{ls}}tels? {{verse|chapter=7|verse=17}} Euen {{ls}}o euery good tree yeldeth good fruites, and the euil tree yeldeth euil fruites. {{verse|chapter=7|verse=18}} A good tree can not yeld euil fruites, neither an euil tree yeld good fruites. {{verse|chapter=7|verse=19}} Euery tree that yeldeth not good fruite, {{ls}}hal be cut dovvne, and {{ls}}hal be ca{{ls}}t into fyre. {{verse|chapter=7|verse=20}} Therfore by their fruites you {{ls}}hal knovv them.

{{verse|chapter=7|verse=21}} Not euery one that {{ls}}ayth to me, {{sup|‖}} Lord, Lord, {{ls}}hal enter into the Kingdom of heauen: but he that doeth the vvil of my father vvhich is in heauen, he {{ls}}hal enter into the kingdom of heauen.⊣ {{verse|chapter=7|verse=22}} Many {{ls}}hal {{ls}}ay to me in that day, Lord, Lord, haue not vve prophecied in thy name, and in thy name ca{{ls}}t out diuels, and in thy name vvrought many miracles? {{verse|chapter=7|verse=23}} And then I vvil cōfe{{ls}}{{ls}}e vnto them, That I neuer knevv you. depart from me you that vvorke iniquitie. {{verse|chapter=7|verse=24}} {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Luc. 6, 47.''}}* Euery one therfore that heareth the{{ls}}e my vvordes, and doeth them: {{ls}}hal be likened to a vvi{{ls}}e man that built his hou{{ls}}e vpon a rocke, {{verse|chapter=7|verse=25}} and the rayne fel, and the fluddes came, & the vvindes blevve, and they beate agayn{{ls}}t that hou{{ls}}e, and it fel not, for it vvas founded vpon a rocke. {{verse|chapter=7|verse=26}} And euery one that heareth the{{ls}}e my vvordes, & doeth them not, {{ls}}hal be like a fooli{{ls}}h man that built his hou{{ls}}e vpon the {{ls}}and, {{verse|chapter=7|verse=27}} and the rayne fel, and the fluddes came, and the vvindes blevve, and they beate agayn{{ls}}t that hou{{ls}}e, and it fel, & the fall therof vvas great.
